gdp_yoy.source: MOSPI Quarterly Estimates of GDP, Q3 FY2025-26 (Oct–Dec 2025), new base year 2022-23 series, released February 27, 2026. Q4 FY26 data scheduled June 7, 2026 — not yet available.

cpi.source: MOSPI CPI Press Release, April 2026 (provisional); released May 12, 2026. May 2026 data due June 12, 2026.

gsec10y.source: Multiple market data sources (TradingEconomics, WorldGovernmentBonds) reporting India 10Y G-Sec at 7.02% on June 1, 2026. CCIL reported benchmark 10Y yield at 6.95% for May 2026 average; June 1 close at 7.02% reflects geopolitical pressure (Iran conflict) pushing yields ~34 bps higher since March 2026.

rate_cut_cycle.note: RBI paused easing cycle at 5.25% repo rate; three consecutive holds (Feb 6, Apr 8, Jun 5 decision pending). Cumulative 125 bps eased Feb–Dec 2025. Neutral policy stance maintained; FY27 CPI projected 4.6% limits further near-term cuts.
rate_cut_cycle.source: RBI MPC Resolution, April 8, 2026 (repo rate held at 5.25%, neutral stance); finnovate.in RBI MPC April 2026 analysis.

gov_capex.note: Union Budget FY2026-27 (Feb 1, 2026) proposes ₹12.2 lakh crore capex (+9% vs FY26 BE of ₹11.21 lakh crore); GFCF grew 7.6% in H1 FY26 confirming investment momentum continues.
gov_capex.source: PIB – Union Budget FY2026-27: Strengthening Capital Goods Sector, February 3, 2026 (pib.gov.in, PRID 2222521).

china_plus_one.note: India FY26 merchandise + services exports hit record USD 860 bn (+4.22% YoY), led by electronics and engineering goods; manufacturing FDI +17% YoY in FY26; PLI scheme generating ₹17 lakh crore in incremental production across 14 sectors.
china_plus_one.source: PIB Press Release on FY2025-26 Annual Export Data, April 15, 2026 (pib.gov.in, PRID 2252272); InvestIndia PLI scheme performance data.

rural_recovery.note: IMD updated SW Monsoon 2026 seasonal forecast to 90% of LPA (below normal); 60% probability of deficient season; core monsoon zone rainfall also projected below normal (<94% LPA). Onset over Kerala around June 4, 2026.
rural_recovery.source: IMD Updated Long Range Forecast for SW Monsoon Seasonal Rainfall (June–Sep 2026), released May 29, 2026 (via PIB PRID 2266479 and IMD X/Twitter).
